provenance.capture: Hash-only public source/review metadata; no histories, scans or identifiers

knee.title: Knee · source-guided dissection
knee.limitation: Incomplete right-limb source surfaces. Guided visibility and camera changes do not validate anatomical boundaries, surgical planes, source orientation, tendon continuity or scan registration. No absent nerve, vessel or tissue is reconstructed. Radiologist review remains required.

steps.title: Knee source overview
steps.caption: Survey all 15 supplied knee surfaces. The long bones remain whole; this incomplete source does not represent the full joint.

steps.title: Extensor tissues
steps.caption: Compare the quadriceps tendon, whole patella and patellar ligament with the original bones. No quadriceps muscle is included in this knee source view.

steps.title: Collateral ligaments
steps.caption: Hide extensor tissues to compare the two named collateral ligament surfaces with whole-bone context. Their attachment footprints are not defined.

steps.title: Cartilage and menisci
steps.caption: With bones hidden, compare the supplied cartilage surfaces and the single grouped meniscus selection. Medial and lateral menisci are not labelled separately.

steps.title: Cruciate ligaments
steps.caption: Compare the ACL and PCL selections beside the whole tibia, fibula and grouped meniscus source. Hiding the femur is only a visibility change.

steps.title: Compare knee stabilizers
steps.caption: Compare all four ligament surfaces with the whole tibia and fibula. The femur is hidden for visibility only. ACL and PCL help limit anterior and posterior tibial translation respectively; MCL and LCL help resist valgus and varus opening. These static surfaces do not simulate loading, injury or measured attachment footprints.

steps.title: Posterior source surfaces
steps.caption: Turn posteriorly to inspect popliteus alongside the supplied PCL and LCL surfaces. The joint capsule, nerves and vessels are absent.

hip-thigh.title: Hip & thigh · source-guided dissection
hip-thigh.limitation: Incomplete right-limb source surfaces. Guided visibility and camera changes do not validate anatomical boundaries, surgical planes, source orientation, tendon continuity or scan registration. No absent nerve, vessel or tissue is reconstructed. Radiologist review remains required.

steps.title: Hip source context
steps.caption: Compare the whole pelvis group and femur with the supplied femoral head cartilage. Acetabular cartilage, labrum and capsule are not supplied.

steps.title: Gluteal surfaces
steps.caption: Show the supplied gluteal and tensor fasciae latae surfaces with whole-bone context. Select gluteus maximus before comparing the other source selections.

steps.title: Compare gluteal muscles
steps.caption: Hide gluteus maximus to inspect the remaining supplied gluteal surfaces. This visibility change does not define a dissection plane.

steps.title: Short rotator surfaces
steps.caption: Compare the six named short rotator source surfaces after hiding the gluteal selections. Their tendon footprints and nearby nerves are not mapped.

steps.title: Iliacus and psoas
steps.caption: Turn to the anterior view to compare the separate iliacus and psoas major selections against the same whole bones. The lumbar plexus is absent.

steps.title: Medial thigh surfaces
steps.caption: Compare the supplied adductor, gracilis and pectineus surfaces. Source fragments retain their original names and are not new muscles.

steps.title: Anterior thigh surfaces
steps.caption: Show rectus femoris, the three supplied vasti and sartorius with the original femur, patella and extensor tissues.

steps.title: Compare the vasti
steps.caption: Hide rectus femoris to inspect the three supplied vastus surfaces with the whole femur and patella. This is a visibility comparison of source meshes.

steps.title: Posterior thigh surfaces
steps.caption: Turn posteriorly to compare both separately named biceps femoris heads with semimembranosus and semitendinosus. Whole femur, tibia and fibula remain in source position.

calf.title: Calf & ankle tendons · source-guided dissection
calf.limitation: Incomplete right-limb source surfaces. Guided visibility and camera changes do not validate anatomical boundaries, surgical planes, source orientation, tendon continuity or scan registration. No absent nerve, vessel or tissue is reconstructed. Radiologist review remains required.

steps.title: Calf source overview
steps.caption: Survey all supplied calf surfaces with whole tibia, fibula and calcaneus. This incomplete specimen does not show every calf tissue.

steps.title: Posterior calf surfaces
steps.caption: Compare the two separately named gastrocnemius heads with soleus and the supplied calcaneal tendon. The bones remain whole.

steps.title: Compare soleus
steps.caption: Hide both gastrocnemius selections to inspect the supplied soleus surface beside the original calcaneal tendon.

steps.title: Deep posterior surfaces
steps.caption: Compare popliteus, tibialis posterior and the two supplied long flexor surfaces with whole-bone context. Nearby nerves and vessels are absent.

steps.title: Anterior calf surfaces
steps.caption: Turn anteriorly to compare tibialis anterior with the supplied long extensor surfaces. Retinacula are not supplied.

steps.title: Fibularis longus
steps.caption: Inspect the single supplied fibularis (peroneus) longus selection beside the whole tibia, fibula and calcaneus. Fibularis brevis is absent.

steps.title: Calcaneal tendon
steps.caption: Return posteriorly to compare the original calcaneal tendon surface with calcaneus, soleus and both gastrocnemius selections. Source continuity is not validated.

foot.title: Ankle & foot · source-guided dissection
foot.limitation: Incomplete right-limb source surfaces. Guided visibility and camera changes do not validate anatomical boundaries, surgical planes, source orientation, tendon continuity or scan registration. No absent nerve, vessel or tissue is reconstructed. Radiologist review remains required.

steps.title: Source foot bones
steps.caption: Compare the separate tarsal surfaces from above. The source Phalanges surface stays one foot-bone group, without digit or bone numbering.

steps.title: Anterior ankle surfaces
steps.caption: Compare the whole tibialis anterior and long extensor source surfaces with tibia, fibula, talus and calcaneus. Tendon footprints are not mapped.

steps.title: Plantar source muscles
steps.caption: Turn below the foot to compare the supplied abductor, flexor digitorum brevis and quadratus plantae surfaces against whole source bones. Plantar coverage is partial.

steps.title: Compare quadratus plantae
steps.caption: Hide flexor digitorum brevis to inspect the supplied quadratus plantae selection with the remaining plantar source muscles and whole bones.

steps.title: Dorsal source muscle
steps.caption: Return above the foot to inspect the single extensor digitorum brevis source selection. No separate extensor hallucis brevis surface is labelled.

steps.title: Long flexor surfaces
steps.caption: Compare tibialis posterior and the supplied long flexor surfaces with whole ankle bones. This visibility view does not map a tunnel or nerve route.

steps.title: Fibularis longus context
steps.caption: Inspect the supplied whole fibularis longus surface with tibia, fibula and foot source bones. No fibularis brevis, retinaculum or validated plantar tendon route is added.

steps.title: Calcaneal tendon
steps.caption: Compare the original calcaneal tendon selection with calcaneus, talus, tibia and fibula. No attachment footprint or tendon repair is represented.

whole.title: Whole source limb · source-guided dissection
whole.limitation: Incomplete right-limb source surfaces. Guided visibility and camera changes do not validate anatomical boundaries, surgical planes, source orientation, tendon continuity or scan registration. No absent nerve, vessel or tissue is reconstructed. Radiologist review remains required.

steps.title: Whole-limb source context
steps.caption: Begin with the supplied pelvis group and whole long bones, then compare talus and calcaneus. This is one incomplete right-limb specimen, separate from the whole-body atlas.

steps.title: Gluteal comparison
steps.caption: Show the three gluteal source selections and tensor fasciae latae with pelvis and femur context. Select gluteus maximus; the source contains no sciatic nerve.

steps.title: Hip source cartilage
steps.caption: Compare the supplied femoral head cartilage with the original femur and pelvis group. No acetabular cartilage, capsule or labrum is supplied.

steps.title: Short rotator comparison
steps.caption: Hide the gluteal selections and compare the supplied short rotator surfaces. Visibility changes are not validated surgical planes or tendon footprints.

steps.title: Iliacus and psoas context
steps.caption: Compare the separate iliacus and psoas major source surfaces with pelvis and femur. Lumbar vertebrae and plexus are not supplied.

steps.title: Medial thigh comparison
steps.caption: Compare the supplied adductor, gracilis and pectineus selections in their unchanged source positions. Nerves, vessels and fascia are not reconstructed.

steps.title: Thigh extensor context
steps.caption: Compare the four quadriceps muscle selections, nearby sartorius and supplied extensor tissues. No mechanical continuity or attachment map is inferred.

steps.title: Posterior thigh comparison
steps.caption: Compare the two separately named biceps femoris heads, semimembranosus and semitendinosus with unchanged long-bone context. This is not a sciatic nerve dissection.

steps.title: Articular knee selections
steps.caption: Hide the bones to compare the supplied cartilage, collateral ligament and grouped meniscus surfaces. No complete joint or individual meniscus segmentation is inferred.

steps.title: Knee cruciate context
steps.caption: Hide the femur and extensor selections to inspect the ACL and PCL surfaces with tibia, fibula and the grouped meniscus source. The menisci are not individually segmented.

steps.title: Posterior calf comparison
steps.caption: Compare both gastrocnemius source selections, soleus and the calcaneal tendon with tibia, fibula and calcaneus. Plantaris and peripheral neurovascular anatomy are absent.

steps.title: Deep posterior selections
steps.caption: Hide the superficial posterior selections and compare tibialis posterior, the long flexors and popliteus. This partial source view does not reconstruct the tarsal tunnel.

steps.title: Fibularis longus selection
steps.caption: Compare the supplied whole fibularis longus selection with tibia, fibula and calcaneus. Fibularis brevis and retinacula are absent.

steps.title: Foot source context
steps.caption: Compare the separately named tarsal surfaces with the supplied Phalanges group. Individual digits, metatarsal identities and complete foot joints are not added by this guide.

steps.title: Partial plantar muscles
steps.caption: Show the four supplied plantar muscle selections with the foot source bones. Select flexor digitorum brevis; this is not a complete four-layer plantar dissection.

steps.title: Dorsal source comparison
steps.caption: Finish with the supplied extensor digitorum brevis and long anterior muscle/tendon surfaces. Separate extensor hallucis brevis, retinacula and insertion footprints are not mapped.
